subject: general
question: Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) and NITI Aayog in collaboration with ______ launched the community Innovators Fellowship (CIF) marking the 'International Day of Women and Girls in Science'.

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) and NITI Aayog have launched the Community Innovators Fellowship (CIF) in collaboration with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to support women innovators in India.**
 
• The CIF aims to encourage and support women entrepreneurs and innovators who are working on innovative solutions to the most pressing problems faced by communities across the country.
 
• The fellowship will provide financial support, mentoring, and networking opportunities to the selected innovators.
 
• The launch of the CIF marks the International Day of Women and Girls in Science, which is celebrated on February 11 every year to promote gender equality in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Institute of Science (IISc) is a premier research institute located in Bangalore. **
 
• **The Ministry of Women and Child Development is a government ministry in India that is responsible for the formulation and implementation of policies and programs for the welfare of women and children. **
 
 
• Smriti Irani is the Union Minister.
 
 
 
• In India, the Ministry of Science and Technology contains the Department of Science and Technology.
 
 
• It's headquarter is in New Delhi.
 
 
 
• The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is a global development agency that works to eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities, and promote sustainable development.
